scientific_integrity: All-depth pointwise theorem supported by a complete elementary counting proof and separate exact integer verification.
scientific_limitations: The depth-one finite-field problem has published solutions and is not claimed as novel.
Possible unlocated stronger local-ring representation results remain an originality risk.
Even-prime and larger matrix-size cases are excluded.
title: Exact two-sum convolution and depth-uniform minorization for special-linear matrices over odd prime-power rings
